intro: Abu Dhabi is one of those places that stays with you long after the trip ends. Grand mosques, museums and theme parks — and it is easier to plan than you might think.

sections.heading: Why visit Abu Dhabi
paragraphs: Abu Dhabi (Middle East) is known for its city, luxury and family experiences. Overall it is on the premium side — worth saving up for, though budget options exist.

sections.heading: Best time to go
paragraphs: The best time to visit is November to March.

sections.heading: How to get there
paragraphs: Direct flights from many Indian cities.

sections.heading: Insider tip
paragraphs: Dress modestly for the Grand Mosque — robes are provided if needed.

How do I reach Abu Dhabi?
faq.a: Direct flights from many Indian cities.

faq.q: Where should I stay in Abu Dhabi?
faq.a: Popular choices: Corniche for the city; Yas Island for theme parks; Saadiyat for beaches.
